target_rationale: 1306 is the target: national geography, ABOG_PLUS_ABU pathway, board_certified_active measure, contract v3.0.0 (current), basis 'URPS subspecialty cert year' -- identical to the basis the simulated cohort is constructed on. The retired v2.1.0 values (1332/1329) use the primary board cert year and are rejected.

urps_artifact.active_in_year_definition: board_certified_active: urps_subspecialty_cert_year <= Y and not retired by Y, within the geography. Keyed on the URPS SUBSPECIALTY certification year (training-accurate, post-fellowship), NOT the primary cert_year. ABOG uses the real sub1startdate (2013+); ABU and unmatched ABOG use a fellowship proxy (primary + 2 urology / + 3 OB-GYN). 33 providers whose URPS cert/proxy postdates 2023 are excluded from the 2023 active count. The canonical 2023 national board-certified active count is 1,306 (1,339 is the roster_snapshot headcount).
urps_artifact.deduplication_rule: ABOG = OB/GYN board-certification (FPMRS/URPS) pathway. ABU enters only as NET-NEW to the ABOG NPI set; dual-boarded general-urology-primary providers held out; reinstated dual-boarded (n=38) kept; retired/unmatched dropped. Active ABOG and ABU NPI sets are provably disjoint (asserted).
